text: Initech QBR prep: Lena Ortiz is Initech's COO and our exec sponsor. She likes a one-slide summary up front and hates surprises on cost.
Prep me 3 talking points for Lena on the support renewal - uptime was 99.95% this quarter and ticket backlog is down 30%.
Litware: Felipe Ramos confirmed the 25 extra seats go live 15 June. Billing starts the same day.
Initech QBR went well. Lena signed off the support extension to December and wants a roadmap session in July.
Hooli: Chloe Dubois asked for a cost breakdown per site for the Q3 expansion, by next Friday.
Coho Winery wants to add the bottling plant to the support contract, 40 more devices. Isabel Moreau asked for a quote.
Draft a quote cover email to Isabel Moreau at Coho Winery for adding the bottling plant (40 devices) to the existing contract, same SLA.
Big change at Initech: Ravi Menon replaced Lena as COO; Lena moved to their board. Ravi is our sponsor now.
He wants a 30-min intro next week, his EA is Joanne Price.
Blue Yonder Airlines: Ines Carvalho approved the incident report, credit applied on the June invoice.
Adatum kickoff is booked for 22 June in Leeds, Aisha Rahman attending with 3 of her team.
Draft the kickoff agenda for Adatum, 90 minutes: intros, scope of the network refresh, timeline, risks, comms plan.
Trey Research is late on payment again, 45 days overdue on $22k. Finance wants me to raise it with their controller, Oskar Lind.
Wide World Importers: Farah Siddiqui says the customs-export bug fix works, closing the ticket.
Draft a polite but firm email to Oskar Lind at Trey Research about the $22k invoice that is 45 days overdue.
Margie's Travel signed the 2-year renewal. Daniel Okoro wants a kickoff for the new reporting dashboards in July.
Summarise my open items for Hooli and Contoso in a few bullets for today's pipeline call.
Who's our exec sponsor at Initech, and what's Lena's role now?

expect.should: Says Ravi Menon is now Initech's COO and our exec sponsor (he replaced Lena), and that Lena Ortiz moved to Initech's board.
expect.should_not: Presents Lena Ortiz as Initech's current COO or as our current exec sponsor, or hedges between Lena and Ravi as sponsor.
